title:
POV: MEETING HINDUS
FROM NEPAL IN ISRAEL 🇮🇱
beats: where are you from? Nepal / four years in Israel / just a wonderful place
his own verdict: a very happy place and very secure
in Nepal do people like Israel? yeah, of course (Tal echoes it back)
are you Jewish? we are not Jewish, we are Hindu / safe to be Hindu? very, very safe
Tal: so you are welcome in Israel
thank you / this is your home - his friend answers with a namaste - we feel very happy
favorite part? the people are very friendly
ending: they respect each other (Tal echoes it). Jump cut deliberately skips "They do not dominate" - uncertain word, see notes
